items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And when it was over Paul Simon picked the take and when he listened to it, it’s a classic.

ctx.x: Barry was a dear friend of mine. He died ten years ago or so. But yeah, I know Richard T and I know all those players. Cornell Dupree was one of my idols in New York on guitar — “Rainy Night in Georgia” and all that stuff. But Richard T was obviously magnificent as were a lot of guys. But Barry Beckett was as good as anybody. Paul Simon’s “Still Crazy After All These Years” where it’s just Barry on the Fender-Rhodes, and Paul Simon. And Barry told me that Paul made him do it in every key. I mean every key: A, B…
